title: Command acknowledgement (device to server)
description: Topic aquapulse/v1/dev/{id}/ack · QoS 1 · not retained. cmdId is null only when the command was so broken that its ID could not be read.

result.description: ok = done · rejected = not done on purpose (expired, duplicate, invalid, unsafe ...) · failed = hardware problem

state.description: State after the command: valve open/closed/fault, pump on/off, mode auto/manual, or null
